meta.name: pre-publish-review
meta.description: Nuclear-grade 16-agent pre-publish release gate. Runs /get-unpublished-changes to detect all changes since last npm release, spawns up to 10 ultrabrain agents for deep per-change analysis, invokes /review-work (5 agents) for holistic review, and 1 oracle for overall release synthesis. Runs ONLY when the user explicitly asks for a pre-publish review — a plain publish/release request MUST NOT trigger this; /publish ships directly. Triggers: 'pre-publish review', 'review before publish', 'release review', 'pre-release review', 'ready to publish?', 'can I publish?', 'pre-publish', 'safe to publish', 'publishing review', 'pre-publish check'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 发布前自动审查代码变更，确保质量达标
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在npm发布前需要多维度自动化代码审查
copy.tagline_en: Automatically review code changes before release to ensure quality
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need multi-agent automated code review before npm publish

howto.what: 装上后,当你要求发布前审查,Claude 会运行 /get-unpublished-changes 检测上次 npm 发布以来的更改,分组后最多启动 10 个 ultrabrain 代理逐项深度分析、调用 /review-work(5 个代理)整体审查、1 个 oracle 发布综合,最后给出就绪评估、版本号建议和破坏性变更清单。
howto.when: 仅在用户明确要求发布前审查时触发,例如说「pre-publish review」「release review」等或询问「ready to publish?」。普通的发布/发布请求不会触发,直接走 /publish。

say.text: 请对当前项目跑一次 pre-publish review。
say.note: Claude 会启动 16 个代理做三层审查。

say.text: 发布前检查一下,现在能安全发布吗?
say.note: 会触发发布综合,给出版本号和风险评级。

say.text: 运行 release review,看看有没有破坏性变更。
say.note: 会重点审查破坏性变更并输出迁移建议。

howto.what_en: On a pre-publish review request, Claude runs /get-unpublished-changes, groups changes, spawns up to 10 ultrabrain agents for deep analysis, invokes /review-work (5 agents) and 1 oracle for synthesis, then outputs readiness, version bump, and breaking changes.
howto.when_en: Only triggers on an explicit pre-publish review request (e.g., 'pre-publish review', 'release review', 'ready to publish?'). Plain publish/release does NOT trigger; /publish ships directly.

say_en.text: Please run a pre-publish review on the current project.
say_en.note: Claude will launch 16 agents for three-layer review.

say_en.text: Check before publishing—is it safe to release now?
say_en.note: Triggers release synthesis, gives version bump and risk rating.

say_en.text: Run a release review and look for breaking changes.
say_en.note: Focuses on breaking changes and outputs migration steps.
